hypothesis: lastRefreshRef is declared as a component-local useRef(0). If the component unmounts and remounts within 2000ms (e.g., page navigation or re-rendering), the throttle state is reset to 0, allowing an attacker or rapid user to bypass the 2000ms throttle and flood the application with trigger-refresh events.

isRinging is a boolean state set to true on open and reset via onAnimationComplete. If the user rapidly toggles the bell open/closed/open within 550ms while isRinging is still true, setIsRinging(true) does not change state value and fails to trigger Framer Motion keyframe re-evaluation, leaving the user with a stagnant bell icon.

itinerary-view.tsx only listens to 'tabidachi-trigger-refresh' while other views listen to both 'tabidachi-trigger-refresh' and legacy 'refresh-active-view'. Furthermore, it does not check document.visibilityState, causing hidden or background tabs to execute redundant reloadTripDetail and reloadCapsules network requests during global broadcast.
